# Platforms and payments

One page per platform and payment provider, made from the same lists as the setup pages, so the two always agree.

| Page | How it is turned on | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| [Twitch](twitch.md) | choose on the Modules page | Twitch chat in site chat, the Twitch player, and Twitch sign-in for your viewers. |
| [Kick](kick.md) | choose on the Modules page | Kick chat in site chat, live detection, and Kick sign-in for your viewers. |
| [Streamplace](streamplace.md) | choose on the Modules page | The stream.place player and its chat. Nothing to register: this site is its own app there. |
| [Ko-fi, Patreon and Streamlabs](donations.md) | choose on the Modules page | Tips and memberships through outside services, shown as alerts and counted on the support bar. They make nobody a supporter here: the site's supporter perks come from a Stripe subscription or a gift sub. |
| [Read-aloud voice (ElevenLabs)](voice.md) | choose on the Modules page | Alerts, paid messages and the bot spoken on stream with an ElevenLabs voice. The sound reaches your stream through the rig page in OBS. |
| [OBS control](obs.md) | module (switch) | One browser source in OBS, the rig page, plays the bot's voice into your stream, draws the bot's avatar, switches scenes on request and pauses the timer on a scene. It connects out from OBS, so it works from any network. Off: the rig page is refused and nothing reaches OBS. |
| [YouTube](youtube.md) | module (switch) | Reads the chat of your YouTube live streams into site chat. Off: nothing is read from YouTube and no YouTube setup page is shown. |
| [Card payments (Stripe)](stripe.md) | module (switch) | Card payments with your own Stripe account: subscriptions, gift subs, tips and points. You are the merchant; the money goes to your Stripe balance. Off: no card checkout, Stripe's webhook address answers "not found" (Stripe keeps its events and retries them for about three days), and card subscribers lose their Supporter perks at once while Stripe keeps charging them. Cancel their subscriptions in Stripe first, or switch back on. |
| [PayPal and Venmo](paypal.md) | module (switch) | Tips and points purchases through your own PayPal Business account, with Venmo when PayPal offers it. Tips, points and, with a billing plan set, the Supporter subscription; gifts are card payments (Stripe). Off: no PayPal button, and PayPal's webhook address answers "not found", so PayPal keeps its events and retries them for about three days. PayPal subscribers (a billing plan set) lose their Supporter perks at once while PayPal keeps charging them. Cancel their subscriptions in PayPal first, or switch back on. |
